AI Notes.value: Type foundry arm of Our Polite Society, a design practice formed 2008 by Jens Schildt and Matthias Kreutzer; members across Stockholm, Hamburg and Montreal (previously Amsterdam). Retail and custom typefaces: Favorite, Placard, Cubic, Facitype (the FACIT Model project draws on Swedish office-machine ephemera), plus Grotesko, Past Perfect, Capitalis Brutalis, Noise Abroad, And Ever, And Ever Ultra, Used Future, Kappla, Restructional Text. 13 typefaces in the catalog as of 2025. Foundry (type house) for this entry; the parent OPS is a broader graphic/identity studio. Small distributed team (Size 2-10). Reviewed on Typographica and Fonts in Use; the Facitype FACIT project was covered by Creative Boom. Site note: ourpolitesocietytype.net (the Website field) now permanently redirects to ops-type.com; Scout may wish to update the Website field to ops-type.com. Work captured as screenshots of the foundry's live interactive specimen viewer (no static raster images on the site; each typeface is rendered in the browser as a live type tester) plus archival project images from the Creative Boom Facit Model article. IG (@ops_type): logged-out context shot captured; cookie dialog was shown but profile identity (handle and name) confirmed on instagram.com. Full-res IG capture deferred to ig.py if needed.
